name: Fraksi TNI/POLRI
summary:
Under the command of General Wiranto, Fraksi ABRI (TNI/Polri) controls 38 unelected seats in the MPR. Cut in half from the 75 seats the military held prior to the January 1999 political laws, yet still voting with discipline whenever Cilangkap issues an order. In April 1999, Inpres No. 2 Tahun 1999 formally separated the National Police (Polri) from the armed forces chain of command, and the high command unveiled its Paradigma Baru ('New Paradigm'): a calculated institutional retreat from front-line Golkar politics designed to preserve the Army's Kodam territorial network and shield senior generals from human rights tribunals.

For now, General Wiranto's pact with the Palace is your pragmatic shield against the daily turmoil of Reformasi. So long as your arrangement with Cilangkap holds, military support cannot fall below an accommodating floor: Kostrad and Brimob battalions will clear riot-torn boulevards in an afternoon, military trucks will move Bulog rice when civilian ports jam, and BAIS intelligence operatives will neutralize Cendana-backed provocateurs before they strike.

That protection is a conditional loan, not a blank check. Push too aggressively against the officer corps' legal immunity, its off-budget business foundations, or its operations in East Timor and Aceh, and your pact with General Wiranto will shatter permanently—leaving ABRI's 38 delegates free to turn against you.
biography:
Born in Yogyakarta in 1947 and commissioned from the National Military Academy in 1968, General Wiranto rose through the Army's territorial and strategic commands after serving four pivotal years as President Suharto's personal adjutant (1989–1993). Appointed Commander of Kodam Jaya, Commander of Kostrad, Army Chief of Staff, and finally Commander of the Armed Forces (Pangab) in February 1998, he stood at the fulcrum of power when Jakarta burned in May 1998. Rather than seizing power in a junta or ordering a bloodbath at the occupied parliament complex, Wiranto nudged Suharto into stepping down, guaranteed the physical safety of the Cendana family, and backed your constitutional succession—promptly stripping his fiery rival, Lt. Gen. Prabowo Subianto, of command over Kostrad twenty-four hours later.

Serving concurrently as Armed Forces Commander and Minister of Defense and Security in your cabinet, Wiranto views himself as the guardian of the state's survival rather than your personal subordinate. Besieged by student fury over the Trisakti and Semanggi shootings and international condemnation over military-backed militias in East Timor, his foremost loyalty is to the cohesion and honor of the TNI officer corps. He will keep the military behind your government for as long as you protect Cilangkap's red lines—and step aside the moment your presidency becomes a liability to the institution.

interactions.text: Deploy Kostrad and Brimob battalions to restore order in the capital
interactions.description: When street demonstrations and sectarian flashpoints threaten to paralyze Jakarta, authorize General Wiranto to position Kostrad mechanized infantry and Brimob riot police around key ministries, commercial hubs, and the Senayan parliamentary complex. Significantly bolsters National Stability, at a minor cost to Popularity and Reformasi Credibility.
interactions.alertMsg: Armored personnel carriers take up positions along Jalan Sudirman and Medan Merdeka, dispersing unruly crowds before nightfall. Commuters and shopkeepers breathe a sigh of relief at the return of order, though student leaders denounce the show of force.

interactions.text: Mobilize ABRI's territorial command trucks for emergency Sembako relief
interactions.description: With civilian distribution networks crippled by credit freezes and hoarding, task the Army's Kodam and Korem logistics battalions with trucking Bulog rice, cooking oil, and kerosene directly from the ports into provincial markets. Boosts Economic Health and Popularity across the regions.
interactions.alertMsg: Convoys of olive-drab military trucks bypass bottlenecked wholesalers and unload subsidized rice and cooking oil directly at district markets, easing food inflation and winning grateful praise from working families.

interactions.text: Direct BAIS military intelligence to disrupt Cendana-funded provocateur rings
interactions.description: Shadowy networks of paid agitators and Jalan Cendana fixers have been busing in provocateurs to turn peaceful rallies into arson attacks. Order the Strategic Intelligence Agency (BAIS) to intercept their couriers and Roll up their safe houses before the next riot can be staged. Improves National Stability and weakens Cendana Influence.
interactions.alertMsg: Working from wiretaps and informant tips, BAIS operatives quietly detain several key paymasters and seize caches of incendiary materials in Jakarta's outskirts, blunting Cendana's street-level sabotage.

interactions.text: Include military welfare foundations inside the state bank recapitalization umbrella
interactions.description: The Army's sprawling network of command foundations (Yayasan Kartika Eka Paksi and regional Kodam ventures) suffered heavy losses during the banking collapse. Quietly fold their distressed commercial banks and joint ventures into the government's recapitalization bond scheme. Drains Economic Health and Reformasi Credibility. Grants 1 Favor with ABRI.
interactions.alertMsg: Cilangkap's financial managers quietly receive their share of state recapitalization bonds. Regional commanders express rare gratitude toward Bina Graha, though Ministry of Finance auditors wince at the balance-sheet cost.

interactions.text: Co-sponsor Wiranto's 'Paradigma Baru' & ICRC rules-of-engagement reforms
interactions.description: Publicly champion Lt. Gen. Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono, Lt. Gen. Agus Widjojo, and General Wiranto's Paradigma Baru ('New Paradigm') doctrine alongside ICRC crowd-control standards—giving Cilangkap the credit for modernizing itself on its own terms without threatening the territorial command structure. Grants 1 Favor with ABRI.
interactions.alertMsg: Unveiled with full ceremonial honors on Armed Forces Day, the 'New Paradigm' wins praise from moderate reformers and foreign defense attaches alike, while reassuring Cilangkap that institutional reform will remain securely in military hands.

interactions.text: End active-duty military secondments to the civilian bureaucracy (Kekaryaan)
interactions.description: Under the New Order's Dwifungsi doctrine, roughly 6,800 active-duty officers sit in civilian posts as provincial governors, district regents (bupati), and ministry secretaries-general. Instruct General Wiranto to enforce a strict choice: resign from active military commission or vacate civilian office. Strains your arrangement with Cilangkap.
interactions.alertMsg: Thousands of seconded officers across the archipelago are forced to choose between their military stars and their civilian desks. Civil-society groups hail the dismantling of Kekaryaan, though territorial colonels grumble over the lost sinecures.

interactions.text: Press Wiranto to sever ABRI's formal institutional alliance with Golkar
interactions.description: For three decades, the military formed the 'A' in the ABG (ABRI–Birokrasi–Golkar) triad that guaranteed Golkar's electoral dominance. Urge General Wiranto to formally sever ABRI's ties to DPP Slipi and pledge strict military neutrality across all contesting parties. Angers Akbar Tandjung's Golkar machine.
interactions.alertMsg: Cilangkap formally declares that ABRI stands 'at an equal distance from all political parties.' Opposition leaders and election monitors applaud the announcement, while Akbar Tandjung's regional chairmen complain they have been left to fight on their own.

interactions.text: Entrust ABRI with exclusive security authority over the East Timor ballot
interactions.description: Reject United Nations and Western appeals for an armed international peacekeeping presence ahead of the August 30 popular consultation in East Timor, leaving security in Dili entirely in the hands of General Wiranto and Kodam IX/Udayana. Damages Reformasi Credibility and International Standing. Grants 1 Favor with ABRI.
interactions.alertMsg: The brass in Cilangkap welcomes your defense of Indonesian sovereignty over the territory. In Dili and Liquica, however, UNAMET observers immediately warn that military-backed pro-integration militias are intimidating voters with total impunity.

interactions.text: Press Cilangkap to commit to a complete phase-out of ABRI's unelected MPR seats
interactions.description: Although Fraksi ABRI's legislative bloc was already halved from 75 to 38 seats, student coalitions and Utusan Golongan reformers are demanding an explicit timetable to end unelected military representation in parliament altogether. Press Wiranto to accept a binding phase-out schedule. Significantly strains your pact with General Wiranto.
interactions.alertMsg: After icy negotiations in Bina Graha, the high command agrees in principle to a timetable phasing out reserved legislative seats. Wiranto privately warns you that the officer corps feels increasingly cornered by civilian politicians.

interactions.text: Commission a state audit into ABRI's off-budget foundations and timber concessions
interactions.description: Less than a third of Indonesian military spending comes from the official state budget; the rest flows through a vast, unrecorded empire of military foundations (yayasan), logging concessions, and protection rackets. Authorizing BPK auditors to open those books will electrify Reformasi advocates and the IMF—but strikes directly at Cilangkap's financial lifeblood and severely strains the Wiranto pact.
interactions.alertMsg: Word of the audit triggers immediate fury across the regional Kodam commands. Wiranto stonewalls the auditors at every turn, Delivering a blunt message to the Palace that threatening the military's off-budget autonomy crosses a dangerous red line.

interactions.text: Hold a midnight consultation with General Wiranto on the eve of the MPR roll call
interactions.description: Unlike the fractured civilian parties in Senayan, Fraksi ABRI's 38 delegates march into the chamber under direct military orders. Sit down with General Wiranto one final time before the ballot boxes open to call in every institutional guarantee you have extended to the armed forces. Automatically cashes in any unspent Favors with ABRI for a decisive loyalty boost.
interactions.alertMsg: General Wiranto listens in measured silence, salutes crisply, and assures you that Fraksi TNI/Polri will cast its ballots in the highest interest of national stability when the roll is called.
